findings.title: Metrics are process-local; durable history depends on the snapshot timer
evidence: Migration 0053 persists snapshots only when the timer runs
findings.impact: A restart resets counters and, if the timer is off in an environment, no history is retained for trend analysis.
findings.recommendation: Make the snapshot timer mandatory in production compose/readiness and document the retention horizon.

report: Observability: /healthz, dependency-aware /readyz, Prometheus /metrics with fixed cardinality, OTel collector retaining traces on a volume (OBS-P2-001 fixed), a committed assurance crontab (OBS-P1-001 fixed), and SLO/incident runbooks. Residual: core metrics are process-local counters; durable history exists only when the snapshot timer is enabled.
